$comment: Pins the two hand-kept copies of SCHEMA_LIMITS. The root suite (tests/data/pinned-copies/field-limits.test.ts) and the MCP suite (packages/mcp-server/src/__tests__/pinned-copies/field-limits.test.ts) each check their own copy against this file, so a limit changed in one copy alone turns one suite red. To change a shared limit, change both copies and this file together. Brief: MODERNIZATION_BRIEF.md, Phase 1 pilot.

knownGaps.note: The MCP server caps ids at 255 characters. The web schema sets no maximum id length.
